Hans Harisson commented on NeuroTechX Conectome EU: "Commentaire de Bryan sur les nouveaux  _"onboarding EU chapter"_ : 

-----------------------------------------------------------------

@Hans harisson FYI we have 3 Chapters in the pipeline for launching/on-boarding that would join the EU Connectome. We do not need to on-board them before BIR 2021 is complete, I am just letting you know now so you can keep them on your radar. The requests are as follows (in the order that they were requested):
NeuroTechX Denmark - new Chapter launch (entirely new community, new team)
NeuroTechMUC (Munich Chapter) - revamp Chapter launch (established community, new team)
NeuroTechX Chapter in Grenoble, France - new Chapter launch (entirely new community, new team)
I think these three will be great opportunities for you to work closely with the guru of Chapter launches, @Mohit Patil. We can discuss further in mid-February."

NeuroTechMUC (Munich Chapter) - revamp Chapter launch (established community, new team)
NeuroTechX Chapter in Grenoble, France - new Chapter launch (entirely new community, new team)
